message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Chen rented a place, employed workers, owed wages 85,361 RMB to 15 workers, refused to pay, escaped, later partially paid 51,000 RMB, remaining debt with IOU. This is refusal to pay labor remuneration. According to correction rule: "If the factual scenario describes an employer or contractor who has completed work but fails to pay the owed wages or labor remuneration to workers, the appropriate charge is '拒不支付劳动报酬' rather than fr". So the crime is "拒不支付劳动报酬". No other crimes mentioned. So output single crime.
